FROM v_units_out_daily u
JOIN v_workcell w ON u.workcell_id = w.workcell_id
WHERE w.workcell = 'KEYSIGHT'
  AND u.date BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-08-08'
GROUP BY u.assembly
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 1
